Meanwhile, Joon Young no longer considers Jung Kyung fondly after she confesses her feelings. Due to his family's finances, Joon Young looks for ways to obtain more loans. After a long, stressful day, Joon Young calls Song Ah and admits he enjoys her company.

As the summer internship comes to an end, Song Ah gets some good news from one of her professors at school. She wants to share the news with Joon Young, but he doesn't respond to her message. Meanwhile, Jung Kyung tells Young In that she broke up with Hyeon Ho. After the fall semester begins, Song Ah meets Joon Young at school.

Joon Young struggles to deal with his family's financial difficulties, his messy friendships, and his teacher's oppressive teaching style. However, he finds himself feeling comfortable and smiling whenever he is with Song Ah. Then, weird rumors about their relationship start to spread across campus.

Song Ah becomes all too aware that people are saying Joon Young is on a different level than she is. She loses confidence and keeps trying to distance herself from Joon Young. Meanwhile, Joon Young reacts coldly when he finds Jung Kyung in front of his house. Afterward, Joon Young calls Song Ah, saying he has something to tell her.

Song Ah and Joon Young finally realize they have mutual feelings for one another, and they have a few blissful moments together. Meanwhile, Hyeon Ho finds out about Joon Young and Song Ah's relationship and gets angry. The stress caused by his broken friendship and the seemingly perpetual cycle of preparing for competitions starts to wear on Joon Young.

Seong Jae suggests that Joon Young talks about his family on TV for publicity. Joon Young feels both insulted and ashamed, but he holds his ground. Meanwhile, Song Ah asks Joon Young if she can visit his place. She keeps feeling Jun Kyung's presence around Joon Young both at his apartment and later on at school.

Chae Yoon points his sword at Lee Do's neck. Still, Lee Do talks to Chae Yoon in a composed manner. Meanwhile, Ki Joon, Jong Soo, and Do Dam start to guess what Lee Do's plan is with the clues they have collected so far.

Secret Roots has kidnapped Prince Gwangpyeong and they put up posters all over the Capital threatening Prince Gwangpyeong's life if Lee Do does not give up the alphabet. Lee Do is upset at the idea of losing his on over his alphabet.

All of Berry Bitty City is gathered around to watch the last snowberrykin melt. As the last bit of snow forms a puddle, a cheer goes up, spring is here! It's now time for the annual BerryFest. But with Princess Berrykin out of town on business, who will be the BerryFest Princess and preside over the festival?! Everyone is abuzz with how to go about choosing the Princess and what her duties will be. Postmaster Bee declares the only fair way to go about it is to hold an election. Everyone agrees.

Strawberry opens her front door to a throng of Berrykins all cheering for the new BerryFest Princess. She is appreciative of their admiration but unsure of exactly what her duties entail. In response the Berrykins bombard her with her duties - major to miniscule. One Berrykin sums it up by telling her she's responsible for presiding over all the activities of the BerryFest to make it the best.

All of Berry Bitty City is excitedly making their way through the berry batch in search of the elusive Wanderberry. It is to be the dessert at the BerryFest Feast. Everyone is milling about searching for it on their own when Blueberry points out that the rules say the BerryFest Princess is in charge of the search. The girls turn to her for direction and she points them where she thinks the berry might be.

programmes.st: Nothing To Fear But Berries Themselves
programmes.d: Overhearing Blueberry reading a story to the baby Berrykins about the scary Galumphalot, Orange is uncharacteristically shaken. She determines she doesn't want anything scary around her, just relaxation. But while the girls are having a hair-styling party at Lemon's salon, a malfunction at the BerryWorks causes the whole town to go dark. And Orange begins to get really anxious.

programmes.st: Where, Oh, Where Has Our Blueberry Gone?
programmes.d: Blueberry has become obsessed with the mystery book detective heroine, Patti Persimmon. She decorates her store with Patti posters and rearranges her shelves to make room for all the Patti books she's ordered. Blueberry begins to neglect outings with her friends and even goes so far as to dress like her idol just to emulate her. She then starts looking for cases to solve around town.

While in the midst of a cake decorating demonstration at the café, the girls are uncharacteristically interrupted by an excited Princess Berrykin. She announces the Berrykins have decided to revive the old tradition of the Berry Bitty Buggy Derby. While the girls enthusiastically recount the stories they've heard about it and ask the Princess questions, Blueberry, carrying enough books to block her view, comes through the door and unknowingly interrupts the Princess.

The grove around Berry Bitty City is abuzz with activity. The Berrykins are using their sparkles to harvest berries, Berrykin Bloom is in his garden spraying flowers with a special solution to make them larger, and Raspberry is nearby gathering flower petals to make perfume. The wind starts to blow and picks up some of the sparkles. The sparkles float along the wind and get combined with some of Berrykin Bloom's solution.

It's time again for the Dance-Off between the Big Bitty City Dance Team and the Berry Bitty City Dancers. Plum is stressed out and frazzled because she desperately wants to win. And the Big Bitty City Dancers are a force to be reckoned with. They are elegant and beautifully synchronized. Plum shows the girls a maze of dance steps that she's choreographed in the hopes of creating a winning piece. The problem is, the contest is only 1 week away!

The girls are all gathered at the café. Strawberry is experimenting making applesauce from scratch with a mallet (and making a mess) while the rest busily make their own wrapping paper and bows for the annual gift exchange they hold in celebration of First Frost. Mr. Longface stops by and Strawberry offers him some fresh applesauce but he declines, as he doesn't care for it. He's only there for some tea and, being that he's new in town, doesn't know what the group is up to.
Raspberry is distraught when she suspects her friends have copied her design on her lantern for the "Glimmerberry Gathering".

While sipping cider in Strawberry's café, the girls muse about how they cannot wait for winter to arrive. They list the various traditions they love about the season but the one they all agree on is the Glimmerberry Ball. Strawberry mentions that she doesn't think the café can hold the party this year because of how the town has grown. The girls decide to split up and search for a new location.

Lemon is ecstatic. She races out of her salon and goes around to the other girls' houses proclaiming that she "did it!" and beckoning them to join her. They follow her back and are completely dazzled by her newest creation - Glamicures. They are brightly colored, jeweled manicures with tiny microchips inside that play songs when the wearer moves her hand. Each girl lines up to receive her new glamicure and soon there is a cacophony of color and sound.

While working in her store, Orange overhears the Berrykins laughing and shouting outside. When she goes to the door to investigate, a clump of dandelion fluff gets blown inside chased by three Berrykins. She watches as they head butt the clump around until it floats back toward Orange. Just as it floats close, she gives it a bat sending it outside and the Berrykins happily chasing after it. Wanting in on the fun, she joins them.

While enjoying lunch in the café, the girls are interrupted by some music coming from the gazebo. They head outside and find Sadiebug and Kadiebug wearing badges and standing by a banner and podium. A group of chairs are set up in front of them. The twins begin to announce, and then argue, that they are starting a club - a good citizens club. The girls are shocked as the twins argue with each other all the time.

For their science fair project, Arnold and Gerald planned to lock themselves in Grandpa's dilapidated greenhouse in the backyard for twenty-four hours.

Arnold and Helga are editors of competing school newspapers. Harold softens when he finds a lost cat and then refuses to give it up to its rightful owner. Arnold eventually persuades Harold to give up the kitty.
After Arnold saves Sid from injury, Sid devotes himself to paying Arnold back with unending kindness. Arnold and Gerald play hookey, but intense paranoia thwarts their day.
When Timberly's doll is kidnapped, Gerald and Arnold track it down. A new classmate is tormented by Helga and the other girls but is eventually accepted.
After being scratched by an organ grinder's monkey, Helga is convinced her days are numbered.Arnold and Gerald attempt to catch the biggest fish in the city pond.
Gerald gets in over his financial head selling a sure-fire product.

AKA — Trash Can Day, Arnold and Gerald must get through the traditional day of hazing 4th graders./After Eugene's pet fish is accidentally killed by Arnold's yo-yo, Arnold vows to get unlucky Eugene a pet that will endure.
Arnold and the rest of his fourth grade friends play the seemingly unbeatable fifth graders in touch football. In the end, the fourth grade smarts win over the brute strength of the fifth graders.
Arnold and Gerald catch a suspicious man on film, and they follow him clue-to-clue.In an effort to win a class poetry contest, Phoebe copies a poem from a book.
Helga experiences a day free of her love/hate obsession Gerald reveals he can't ride a bike, and Arnold helps him overcome his fear and humiliation.
Arnold trains Grandpa to take on his old Chinese checkers nemesis, Robby Fisher. Miriam decides to visit her mother after learning that Big Bob and Helga are on vacation at the same time.
Like his Grandfather before him, Arnold competes in the annual block party eating contest.  After intense training, Arnold meets an area eating legend, Seymour “The Disposal,” in a final showdown.
After the kids find out that Big Bob is planning on cutting down “Mighty Pete” the oldest tree in the neighborhood, Arnold organizes a campaign to save the tree.
Eugene becomes disillusioned about his life after learning that his favorite movie action hero doesn't do his own stunts.  Arnold helps him out of his funk.

Flavin returns, sparking a gang war, and helps Dylan develop as a Paradine.
A crystal that can restore the Andromeda's power is discovered, but in order to get it, Dylan must work for the mine's owner - who uses slave labor.
Tunnels are discovered on Seefra which can be used to reach eight other Seefra planets.
When an old man is killed, Beka, Rhade, and Harper are the main suspects and stand trial.
Rhade leads the rebels in a battle against a warlord on Seefra-5. A scientist previously thought dead helps Harper rebuild the quantum teleporter.
Dylan discovers that Beka's boyfriend was really Drago Musevini, and he used Beka's DNA to create the Nietzscheans. She is their Alpha Matriarch.
Beka and Rhade find a test that will either grant them great wealth or drive them to madness.
Harper discovers a program built into the Seefra system that can destroy eight of the planets, likely as a defense mechanism. Trance tries to stop this.
While Harper works on a way to save the Seefra system, a spy sneaks aboard Andromeda and attacks Beka.

programmes.st: Saving Light From a Black Sun
programmes.d: An attempt is made to fix the blinking sun of Seefra, but Trance is replaced by a doppelganger.
When Dylan is badly injured in a lab explosion, he travels through a series of alternate realities.
Rommie is rebuilt to help evacuate the Seefra system.
A warlord convinces his followers that the approaching destruction of the outer planets is a plot to make it easier to loot their planet.

programmes.st: Chaos and the Stillness of It
programmes.d: Dylan, Rhade, and Beka work together to rescue Trance from Methus-2 and Harper from General Burma.
The crew finally makes it out of the Seefra system, and discover Dylan is the last Paradine; the World Ship wasn't destroyed, and Nietzscheans have begun their plan to destroy Earth.
In the series finale, the final battle to save the New Systems Commonwealth begins.
After being left stranded near a black hole, Capt Dylan Hunt is discovered by a mercenary salvage ship to find he has been frozen in time for 300 years.

Ghiaccio's Stand, White Ice is able to envelop him like a bodysuit and able to freeze everything around him to extremely low temperatures. Giorno and Mista somewhat make it to Venice, despite being partially frozen by Ghiaccio...

programmes.st: The Final Mission From the Boss
programmes.d: By revealing to each other a fearless embrace of the unknown, Giorno and Mista emerge victorious against Ghiaccio. Now, a single member of Bruno’s group must face a single bell tower, a single elevator shaft, and a single menacing task.

In the crypt of a Venetian church, Bruno discovers not only the brutal truth behind the Boss’s true intentions but also the unstoppable Stand power he wields, a power that leaves Bruno in a pool of blood and in a moral quandary.
Peer into the complex personal pasts of Bucciarati and his fellow gang members, and uncover the thread that unites this diverse group of fighters into a single team and single expression of resolve.

Bruno and team, now self-chosen traitors, learn from Trish during a moment of calm at a Venetian café a trip to Sardegna is vital. Chaos, then, erupts as Narancia loses his tongue and ability to speak the truth.

As Giorno is teleported between puddles with Squalo’s shark attached firmly to his jugular, Narancia tries to sniff out the perpetrator using his CO2 tracer but is inhibited by Tiziano’s tongue-fusing Stand, frustrating himself and Bruno’s team.

Bruno et al head to Marco Polo airport to venture to Sardegna to discover the truth behind Trish’s father. On the tarmac, however, is a swollen, neckless Stand user who, the team discovers while airborne, is linked to the freshly severed fingers onboard

At cruising altitude, Trish faces a voracious and fleshy mass of a Stand that strikes at the slightest movement. Meanwhile, Giorno’s incessantly pulsating broach, the key to the team’s survival, lies waiting—as does an unseen force within Trish.

programmes.st: A Little Story From the Past ~My Name Is Doppio~
programmes.d: Bruno and team make an emergency landing in Sardegna where the Hitman Team leader, Risotto, is also determined to uncover a certain mystery. Doppio, a timid, wide-eyed teen, the result of a seemingly impossible pregnancy, has his own goals on the island.

Having discovered there is more to skittish Doppio than meets the eye, Risotto uses his Stand to manifest various metallic instruments of torture from within his enemy. Fortunately for Doppio, a way to foresee the inevitable offers a glimmer of hope.

programmes.st: Under a Sky That Could Come Falling at Any Moment
programmes.d: A picturesque Sardinian cliff becomes the bloody backdrop to Doppio’s sudden dominance over Risotto, courtesy of Narancia’s own Stand. On the beach below, Abbacchio works to rewind time 15 years to identify the identity of a certain photographer.
Witness destiny unfold for Trish and the rest of Bruno’s team as her father’s cryptic presence and arcane abilities pull the crew into battles of unspeakable brutality.

programmes.st: Get to the Collessium in Rome!
programmes.d: With Abbacchio’s replaying ability interminably stamped in stone, Bruno and team analyze the cryptic face and fingerprints left behind when a mysterious call arrives.

No sooner than Bruno and team set foot on the shore near Rome the team finds a flesh-eating mold devouring everyone in sight. It's the work of Cioccolata, made worse by his partner Secco, who records the tortured faces of his victims to be viewed later.

Branching off from Bruno, who opts to tackle the underground swimmer Secco, Giorno and Mista chase Cioccolata as he flies to spread rotten ruin upon Rome. Their battles unfold in front of a mystery ally silently awaiting their arrival at the Colosseum.

One fierce battle ends in Cioccolata’s defeat, but another unfolds after Secco listens to Cioccolata’s revealing final voicemail. Bucciarati sinks into an intense underground struggle to stop Secco from reaching the secret stationed at the Colosseum.
Sitch attempts to recruit various cutthroats, villains, and assassins of the underworld to help the Hero Association.
Garou issues a declaration of war on the Hero Association, Hellish Blizzard issues an ultimatum, and Genos decides to eliminate his master’s stalker.
Garou, out hunting heroes, can barely contain his excitement when he gets the chance to battle the S-Class hero 'Tanktop Master.'
Metal Bat guards some VIPs while Saitama has disguised himself as Charanko in order to enter the “Super Fight” martial arts tournament.
Yuki wakes up a vampire, and her memory of her childhood returns. She now remembers her father, her mother, and her brother.
Yuki now understands who she really is. Worried about Zero, she sneaks out of her room to find him. Zero cannot accept Yuki’s new self, and he points the Bloody Rose gun at her.
Absorbing Kaname’s blood finally revives Rido. The vampires all suspect this, and an unsettled mood enshrouds the Academy.
In order to protect the academy, the Headmaster confronts the head of the Hunter Society while Rido is still on the rampage.
Light gives Kiyomi the order to finish off Near.
Near, along with the SPK, meets Light and the task force at a warehouse for the final showdown.
Though Mikami has written all the investigators' names in the Death Note, a minute passes and everyone is still alive.
Brilliant but bored high school student Light Yagami suddenly finds himself holding the power of life and death in his hand, the power of the Death Note.
While the world's criminals continue to drop dead, L meets by computer with representatives from various nations.
Ryuk, the Shinigami, or god of death, who dropped the Death Note into the human world, warns Light that someone is on his trail.
The Diversion Team find themselves in serious trouble when the 1st Division brings out their secret weapon, the Iron Spider.
Ibara and the Diversion Team are nervously waiting for the train to arrive when they are attacked yet again by the Ozu Sisters.
Ibara and the other passengers rejoice after their train has successfully escaped from the Zone.

programmes.st: Christina Trevanion and Paul Laidlaw, Day 2
programmes.d: Antiques hunters Christina Trevanion and Paul Laidlaw shop across Gloucestershire and Northamptonshire before going head-to-head at an auction in Evesham, Worcestershire.

programmes.st: Christina Trevanion and Paul Laidlaw, Day 3
programmes.d: Travelling through Hertfordshire, Buckinghamshire, and the West Midlands, Paul Laidlaw uncovers a hidden gem that could win him the trip. All is revealed when he and Christina Trevanion auction their lots in Nantwich, Cheshire.

programmes.st: Christina Trevanion and Paul Laidlaw, Day 4
programmes.d: Christina Trevanion and Paul Laidlaw travel through Shropshire and Worcestershire. Paul gets security clearance to visit Iron Mountain and Christina learns about the origins of the modern Olympic movement in Much Wenlock.

programmes.st: Christina Trevanion and Paul Laidlaw, Day 5
programmes.d: Paul Laidlaw and Christina Trevanion are taking in the delights of Staffordshire and Cheshire. Paul has had amazing success on this trip; can Christina catch up as they head towards their final auction in Northwich?

programmes.st: Anita Manning and David Harper, Day 1
programmes.d: Antiques experts David Harper and Anita Manning go head-to-head as they road trip through North England and into southern and central Scotland, heading to an auction in Knutsford, Cheshire.

programmes.st: Anita Manning and David Harper, Day 2
programmes.d: David Harper and Anita Manning travel through Yorkshire. Along the way, David learns about a 500-year-old mystery and Anita meets two inspirational Land Girls before they head towards the auction in Harrogate.

programmes.st: Anita Manning and David Harper, Day 3
programmes.d: After a successful last auction, David Harper has the lead, but Anita Manning is hot on his heels as they shop in Yorkshire and County Durham before heading into Newcastle for the auction.

programmes.st: Anita Manning and David Harper, Day 4
programmes.d: It's the penultimate leg for antiques hunters Anita Manning and David Harper. Starting in Northumberland, England, and crossing the border into Scotland, they search for hidden gems before heading to auction in Kinbuck, Stirlingshire.

programmes.st: Anita Manning and David Harper, Day 5
programmes.d: David Harper and Anita Manning travel to the Isle of Bute, Glasgow and Renfewshire. They both take a massive risk in a bid to win the week, but who will come out on top when they head to the auction in Paisley?

programmes.st: Phil Serrell and Natasha Raskin, Day 1
programmes.d: A new pair of auctioneers, Philip Serrell and Natasha Raskin, take to the open road in search for treasure. On their first day, they travel through Wales and end at an auction in Llanelli, Carmarthenshire.

programmes.st: Phil Serrell and Natasha Raskin, Day 2
programmes.d: Antiques hunters Philip Serrell and Natasha Raskin take in the delights of South West Wales before crossing into England and heading to an auction in Newent, Gloucester.

programmes.st: Phil Serrell and Natasha Raskin, Day 3
programmes.d: Philip Serrell and Natasha Raskin shop in Hertfordshire, Oxfordshire and Buckinghamshire before heading to West London for a crucial auction.

programmes.st: Phil Serrell and Natasha Raskin, Day 4
programmes.d: Natasha Raskin is playing catch up as she and fellow auctioneer Philip Serrell take a trip around Sussex and Kent before heading to their penulitimate auction in Rayleigh, Essex.

programmes.st: Phil Serrell and Natasha Raskin, Day 5
programmes.d: It's the last day for Natasha Raskin and Philip Serrell, and they cover Berkshire and Hampshire. But who will win at the final auction in Salisbury?

programmes.st: Mark Stacey and Thomas Plant, Day 1
programmes.d: Thomas Plant and Mark Stacey begin their adventure in Kent. Along the way, Thomas visits the life-saving underground world of Ramsgate, and Mark finds out about the science behind a lighthouse in Dover.

programmes.st: Mark Stacey and Thomas Plant, Day 2
programmes.d: Mark Stacey and Thomas Plant continue their trip through the Kent countryside. Mark is trailing behind, but can he catch Thomas when they head to an auction in Paddock Wood?

programmes.st: Mark Stacey and Thomas Plant, Day 3
programmes.d: Antiques experts Thomas Plant and Mark Stacey are halfway through their road trip, and they shop in Essex and Suffolk before making their way to an auction in Cambridge.

programmes.d: Flip plays a huckster; the Supremes join Flip & Frost for a secret agent and haunted castle skits; Willie Tyler does ventriloquism.
Felipe Luciano hosts this showcase of Latin music on Soul! Features musicians Tito Puente and Willie Colon, accompanied by their musical groups.
Female singing trio LaBelle and conga drum/bongo musician Mongo Santamaria, are guests of Ellis Haizlip.
When Katherine's rich uncle falls in love with the leading lady of a theatrical performance, Webster and Katherine's debuts are in danger.

programmes.st: Doing Time at the Community Center
programmes.d: A convicted gambler undergoing rehab has a profound influence on Webster.
Katherine joins a bowling league hoping to persuade the sponsors to help with one of her programs, unaware they are such horrible people.
Webster gets a brand new bike, but ends up getting a ticket from a cop.
When Frieda gets sick and can't make it to the science fair, Webster has to come to the rescue.
When Tia becomes Tamera's new boss at Rocket Burger, they both learn a lesson in responsibility
While the twins go in search of a Halloween rave, Lisa and Ray attend a fancy party thrown by a prospective client.
Tia and Tamera think they're in for a "free ride" when Ray starts dating their science teacher.
When Ray and Lisa take the girls to Hawaii for Thanksgiving, they're forced to share their condo with their "exes," who have begun dating each other.
While Ray and Lisa frantically search for the twins, who are missing in Hawaii, Roger opens the Campbell/Landry home to hobos for Thanksgiving dinner.
After Moesha and Kim have a huge fight, Moesha is surprised when MTV shows up at her door to film her bringing her best friend Kim to meet her favorite singer.  Leanne Rimes guest stars.
Moesha wants to boycott her debutante ball when she learns one of the girls is thrown out of the ceremony because she is pregnant.
When Moesha is once again rejected from her friends’ band, we enter a black and white parody of I LOVE LUCY wherein Lucy (Moesha) tries to get into Ricky’s show.

programmes.st: Home Is Where The Car Is
programmes.d: Moesha is disappointed when she is not appointed valedictorian of her senior class.  She discovers the boy who has been appointed is homeless.
At a slumber party, Moesha and her friends reminisce (with clips from past episodes) about the past four years together.
In charge of the big choir competition, Mary must make room in her have for the visiting choir's deacon, who is notoriously arrogant, thoughtless and pushy.
Alarmed by Brenda and her friends' casual attitude about teen pregnancy, Mary uses some unusual methods to teach them a lesson about parenting that they'll never forget.
Mary is delighted to learn that Lester will be named 'Man of the Year' by the local Men's Club...and distraught upon discovering she's not allowed to attend the special ceremony.
To protest the opening of a sleazy club in her neighborhood, Mary dreams of running the varmints out of town.
An unruly customer challenges Eddie to a fight; Nicolette and Holly try being roommates.
While trying to help Holly, Malcolm finds himself juggling three dates at the same time.
Eddie's new band jeopardizes his work at the garage.
A TV commercial inadvertently turns Malcolm McGee's into a gay bar.
When Eddie buys a new couch, he doesn't have enough money to pay the rent.

Invited to dinner at the Sanford home, Fred's fiancée Donna brings along a patient who is in her care. Fred is shocked when the man, apparently a healthy specimen, makes it obvious he thinks of Donna as more than a nurse.
Murphy stars as mild-mannered Norbit, who gets a second chance at love with his childhood sweetheart, Kate. However, obstacles may make this romance slightly more difficult than expected.

When Pootie’s one-man war against greed, injustice, and unwholesome consumer products starts cutting into profits at LecterCorp, the company’s demented CEO plunges him into a super-funk by swiping his magical belt!
Leon loses his radio show because of his X-rated on-air comments. He then gets a letter from a former flame promising him a lifetime of wealth and happiness, and things start looking up!

Join EDDIE MURPHY on an unforgettable comic quest to the New World. As an African Prince, it's time for him to find a princess. The mission leads him and his most loyal friend (ARSENIO HALL) to New York. Watch Murphy and Hall in classic cameo roles!
Eddie Murphy gives "the performances" of his career -- playing seven roles! -- in this hilarious comedy about a genetics professor who experiments with his own fat-reducing serum.

programmes.t: The Nutty Professor II: The Klumps
programmes.d: Eddie Murphy and America's funniest family are back for seconds in the comedy sequel about what happens when Sherman Klump's nutty alter ego, Buddy Love, starts throwing his weight around!

When Mark's demanding employer, P.J., tells him she is going to marry her old boyfriend and quit her job, Mark has to decide if he should tell her a secret that could make her cancel the wedding. Queen Latifah guest stars and sings "Just Another Day."
Mark and Vanessa make a bet on who can go the longest without telling a lie.
When Vanessa applies for a job at a conservative Christian radio station, she tells the manager that Mark is her husband and Geneva is her wild cousin.

When Vanessa shows Geneva how to have a good time, Geneva hits on a police officer who mistakes them both as prostitutes. They both are arrested, and Mark is arrested while trying to bail them out of jail.
P.J. threatens to discharge Mark when his student, Earvin, quits school. Geneva can't afford to buy a new bicycle for her daughter, Nicole.
Mark introduces Geneva to a college teacher who asks her to marry him.
Mark plots to reunite his parents after his mother, Dorothy (Ja'net DuBois), leaves her husband of 35 years and moves in with Mark. Richard Roundtree guest stars.
Mark avoids P.J.'s phone calls and learns, too late, that she had good news. Geneva plays a trick on Vanessa to teach Nicole a lesson.
Still angry at Frank for keeping his true relationship to Dorian a secret for so long, Moesha decides not to introduce her father at an upcoming 'Businessman of the Year' awards banquet.
Hoping to boost the confidence of her new roommate, Theresa, Moesha asks Hakeem’s good-looking friend to ask Theresa on a date – but can’t leave well enough alone when the date is a success.
Moesha, Niecy, and Hakeem go to Santa Barbara for Spring Break. A campus rival spreads false information that Mo is 'easy' when her ex-boyfriend shows interest in Moesha.
Having been neighbors and friends nearly all their lives, Moesha and Hakeem wonder if there is more to their relationship.
Janet convinces Michael to have a medical procedure.
Jr. dares Claire to eat Michael's slice of lemon meringue pie.
Jay loses her job and becomes a homemaker.
Michael and Janet's romantic overtures are seen on the web.

When Mona and Dee Dee decide to find the perfect man for each other as birthday presents, Dee Dee quickly finds Mona’s date, James, but even with the help of Spencer and Adam, Mona struggles desperately to find a date for Dee Dee.

programmes.st: The Big Advice to Put It On Ice Episode
programmes.d: When sexual tension leads to conflict in the workplace between Spencer and Mona, Dee Dee and Adam encourage them to close the book on their romantic feelings for each other.

programmes.st: The Big One Wedding And A Funeral Episode
programmes.d: Mona and Dee attend a wedding of one of Dee's ex-boyfriends Neil, while Phyllis and Big Dee attend the funeral of someone they were both once intimately involved with.

programmes.st: The Big Don't Leave Me This Way Episode

programmes.d: Shawn comes up with a risky plan to deal with Clone.
Isaac and his father reach a compromise regarding Myth.
Team Barefoot takes on the defending champions in the semi-finals.
Wolf Army uses the Sniper Strike during the semi-finals.
Wolf Army scores twice using Normandy Formation.
Shawn is frustrated and thinks the team should just quit.

Shishigami escapes from a dozen officers, but he has become a wanted man in connection to the home invasion spree; Shishigami stays with Shion Watanabe, a classmate who has feelings for him; Inuyashiki learns to use his robot abilities.

As Shion believes he is innocent, Shishigami confesses to her that his body is a robot and has taken many lives in order to feel alive again; he informs her that he will kill everyone in the country; Shion begs Shishigami not to leave her behind.

A special forces team bursts in to apprehend Shishigami; Shion and her grandmother are shot in the crossfire, and Shishigami manages to grab them before escaping; one day, Mari sees her father and Ando together; Shishigami attacks a police station.
As the news reports on Shishigami's attack on the police station, Shishigami hijacks a broadcast signal to publicly declare war on Japan, claiming he will kill 100 people immediately.
The day after the mass killings in Shinjuku, Shishigami begins dropping airplanes onto the city; after receiving word from Ando, Inuyashiki manages to stop a number of them from crashing.

Saving many lives in Shinjuku, Inuyashiki returns home to open up to his family about his robot body; his family accepts him, and they embrace; after losing both arms, Shishigami goes to Ando who condemns him and Shishigami disappears.
Two students get lost on the way to locate an island treasure.
Onizuka thinks that his lost students have found the treasure, but in reality one of them has just saved the other's life.
Anko dreams of and watches every one of Yoshikawa's moves after he saved her life.
The surviving seven go to battle for Head of Household, but will they survive Johnny Mac the demented dentist? Plus, who will be the unlucky block buddies?
Will the Power of Veto save one of the nominees?  Plus, will Felicia put Cirie on Jag's nominee radar?

Will Blue be blindsided and sent to Jury?  And which Houseguest will leave second?  Because it's Double Eviction night, baby!  A crazy, unpredictable, and heart pounding week's worth of gameplay, all in one night.

Tonight see all the begging, pleading, and strategizing that you didn't see durning the double; and with only five remaining winning Head of Household is more important than ever. Plus, two more house guests will hit the hot seat.
The Power of Veto is on the line.  But they'll have to survive the Swamp Slasher if they want the Power.

Either Felicia or Cirie will be the next sent to Jury.  Will Jag get Matt on board to betray his friend Cirie?  Plus, who will become the Head of Household and punch their ticket to Finale Night?  And, what's been going down at the Jury House?

It's the last Veto competition of the season.  Where the winner determines who has the sole vote to evict.  Find out who joins Bowie Jane in the final three.  Plus, BB 24 winner Taylor Hale returns to discuss the record breaking 100-day season.
Matt, Jag, and Bowie get an emotional surprise from home and look back on the craziest moments from this season.

Bowie, Jag, and Matt go to battle in the three part final Head of Household competition.  Who will emerge victorious and earn the power to cast the last eviction vote of BB 25?  Plus, the Jury returns to choose the winner of the $750,000 grand prize.

Over the next two nights 16 strangers will embark on the journey of a lifetime; competing for 90 straight days in the ultimate social experiment! Throughout the summer they will battle for safety and power, navigating cutting edge twists and turns that
How will the second group of eight react to the Tech-tacular Twist?  Plus... with two new competitions in play, who will win a secret game changing power?  And who else's game will be downgraded?
Tonight the upgrade powers will be revealed, the first Head Of Household will be crowned, and A.I.N.S.L.E.Y has an atomic game changing announcement.
It's the first Power of Veto competition of the Summer! Plus Angela hurts feelings with an epic meltdown.

Kimo, Matt, and Kenney enter the BB A.I. Arena.  Who will win the inaugural game-changing competition?  And which two Houseguests will remain on the Chopping Block?  Who will be the first booted from BB 26!?
With Angela's reign of power over, who will become the new Head of Household and which three Houseguests will land on the chopping block? Plus, will Quinn unleash his secret deep fake HoH power?
Will the Power of Veto save one of the nominees? Plus, Angela once again finds herself in the center of some drama.
Linda's son Danny tries to plan his mom a surprise baby shower, but Philip has other plans to surprise Linda and asks her to marry him by singing and playing the piano.
Linda ask Ella Payne to help plan her wedding. Meanwhile, Curtis wants Floyd to pay him back for his investment in the diner.
Drew reveals her love for Danny.
Linda has to tell P.J. and Caroline that she's engaged to their father.
Linda meets Philip's ex in-laws; her family comes along.
Hattie prepares for spring cleaning at the diner; Linda explains why she can't move in with Phillip.
Linda threatens to call the wedding off if Philip does not change the furniture in his house.
Philip allows Linda to redecorate the house in whatever way she chooses.
After Hattie finds out that Danny got a promotion, she asks him to help pay for Linda's wedding.
Linda asks Hattie if she'll stay and help her when the baby comes, because she doubts that Philip will help with the newborn.
Danny shows Drew's cousin around for the weekend, and falls for her fast.
Troy and Danny inevitably do something stupid in Las Vegas. In the last minute, Linda's water breaks while she is 6 months pregnant.
A guys' night out goes awry, resulting in lost recollections due to alcohol-fueled blackouts and the disappearance of Nick's wedding ring.
Nick attends his high-school reunion but must face an embarrassing incident from his past. Meanwhile, Lindsey throws a party.
Nick suffers a concussion.
Nick worries about his mortality and creates a bucket list featuring overly dangerous activities. Meanwhile, Kevin and Troy launch an underground candy ring at school.
Nick meets a famous actor, who shadows Nick in preparation for a role. Meanwhile, Kevin gears up for a spelling bee.
Nick is enlisted to host a charity walkathon. Meanwhile, Marilyn's bracelet goes missing, and the children train for their participation in the charity walk.

programmes.st: The Hand on a House Episode
programmes.d: Nick and others enter a contest to win a house.
A new morning show is launched at the station, but Nick must cohost it with a self-serving reality star. Meanwhile, Marilyn moves in with the family.
A newlywed couple (Terry Crews, Essence Atkins) with two children face various blended-family obstacles in this sitcom based on the 2005 film of the same name. First up
Cash-flow problems strike the family when Suzanne's credit issues surface and Nick's work necessitates a new van.
Nick tries to help his mother forge bonds with Kevin and Lindsey. Meanwhile, Suzanne gets the day off.
Young Kevin gets a kick out of soccer, but Nick doesn't see the appeal. Meanwhile, Lindsey's secretiveness exasperates Suzanne, who then snoops online into her teen daughter's private life.

Linda asks Hattie if she'll stay and help her when the baby comes, because she doubts that Philip will help with the newborn.
Danny shows Drew's cousin around for the weekend, and falls for her fast.
Troy and Danny inevitably do something stupid in Las Vegas. In the last minute, Linda's water breaks while she is 6 months pregnant.
Heartbroken, Linda has to put up with Danny's impulsive decisions.
Troy and Sam zero in on Danny.
Danny has to deal with how his friends and family feel about his wife.

Junior arrives in Las Vegas to take the guys out for a spin on the Strip, and Shine contemplates giving up his guest artist spot at 9MAG. Things get awkward for everyone when Van and Jenn decide to head to the altar.

After Jenn and Van's Vegas chapel disaster, Charmaine tries to get the trip back on track with one last Vegas 9MAG pool party. Jenn and Van hash it out and Lily finally confronts Junior and Adriana. Phor spirals into a dark place.
Junior is officially back at 9MAG and Charmaine hooks Ryan up with a celebrity client, Erica Mena. Bella reconnects with an old flame, and the gang gets together for a 9MAG Friendsgiving.

programmes.st: I Didn't Say I Hate Her (I Just Don't Like Her)
programmes.d: All of 9MAG reacts to what happened on Friendsgiving. Junior gets in touch with himself and his past, Don expands his horizons and Charmaine outs Lily as a racist.

programmes.st: I Hope You Make it to America
programmes.d: Ryan gets an ominous call for a meeting from the building management to discuss the future of 9MAG, Lily uses her break from the shop to focus on her art, Charmaine decides to organize a protest and Van does whatever it takes to win Jenn back.

Ryan toils in secrecy on a new mystery shop while Van scares some sense into his daughter's bae. Rising actor Don ponders a move to NYC. Phor shines in the studio while Charmaine wants answers about her future with 9MAG. Ryan debuts his dope new shop
Black Ink throws a birthday party for Sassy that turns into an out of control Mixxxy bash and all hell breaks loose. Dutchess goes ballistic after Alex hits on Caesar. Presented by VH1.

programmes.st: Black Ink Crew What Happens in Vegas…
programmes.d: The Black Ink Crew is heading to Vegas to be part of the biggest tattoo convention in the world. Alex has gone M.I.A. and the crew wonders if she is going to show up at all. Presented by VH1.

programmes.st: Black Ink Crew This, That, and the Third
programmes.d: O'S**t is put in charge of the shop while Ceaser goes down South with Dutchess to meet her parents. When Alex finally arrives back at Black Ink, Dutchess has a few things to say to her. Presented by VH1.

programmes.st: Black Ink Crew In the Dirty, Dirty
programmes.d: Down in North Carolina, Ceaser meets Dutchess's entire family and faces questions about marriage and kids. While there, Cease gets a call from Harlem and is surprised to hear that O'S**t's reign has come to an abrupt end. Presented by VH1.

programmes.st: Black Ink Crew So Much on My Biscuit
programmes.d: Ceaser and Dutchess cut their trip short to pick up O'S**t from "The Barge," the New York City prison he has been locked up in for days. Alex and O'S**t face each other for the first time since the night he went to jail. Presented by VH1.

programmes.st: Black Ink Crew Krazy with a "K"
programmes.d: When the Black Ink Crew decide to host a charity art show for local kids, Puma and Dutchess bump heads while planning the event. Ceaser sides with Dutchess, leaving the guys in the shop to question his loyalty and business sense. Presented by VH1.
Dutchess reveals a secret to Ceaser that she has kept to herself for weeks. Puma shocks Sassy with big news about him and Quanni. Ted drops a bomb on Ceaser about a pregnant Mixxxy. Presented by VH1.

programmes.st: Black Ink Crew Dropping the "M" Bomb
programmes.d: Dutchess makes a peace offering at the shop, apologizing for her bad behavior and fills everyone in on her heart condition. Alex confides in her old tattoo artist about her frustrations with the Black Ink crew. Presented by VH1.

When the woman who brought Ceaser up in the tattoo world visits the shop for a memorial tattoo from Cease, she has some strong opinions about his relationship with Dutchess. Alex and Dutchess finally meet face to face. Presented by VH1.

The Black Ink Crew is back! Ceaser & Puma's friendship comes to an end when Puma oversteps his boundaries. Dutchess and Ceaser question whether their relationship is strong enough to withstand the stress of Black Ink's newfound success. Presented by VH1.

When the electric company arrives and pulls the power because Cease hasn't paid the bill, the crew can't work and they are forced to close the shop. Recording artist Erica Mena stops by the shop to have Dutchess cover a tattoo. Presented by VH1.

Danny and Baez are determined to get justice for a traumatized young woman who was held hostage, despite her resistance to press charges.

Intent on bringing justice to Lieutenant Gormley after he is beaten by a mob outside his home, Danny and Frank enlist the aid of Detective Anthony Abetemarco, who has a personal connection to the neighborhood where the attack occurred.

Danny and Baez investigate the death of an elderly woman who was shot in her home by a stray bullet. Also, Frank faces ridicule from his department when he disciplines a disrespectful cop, and Erin steps in to help her detective, Anthony.

Erin and Anthony try to prevent the deportation of a prominent community activist, Coryna Garza (Judy Reyes), who isn't a citizen, and Frank must decide if the NYPD will participate in the U.S. Marshals' high-profile raid of a local gang.

As Frank contends with a whistleblower within the NYPD who claims to have evidence of abuse of power in the organization, Danny and Baez investigate the case of a woman who was struck by a car under suspicious circumstances.
When a key witness in Danny's case is killed just before testifying, Erin angers Danny by enlisting Anthony (Steve Schrippa) to help him find the killer.

After Emily Harrison (Danielle Savre) tells Danny and Baez she's concerned her abusive ex-boyfriend will repeat his behavior with his new girlfriend, Emily becomes the prime suspect when he's murdered.
Frank is left with minimal information to find a missing boy when a conflicted priest who could help won't break the seal of confession.

When the son of Frank's most outspoken critic in the African-American community, Reverend Darnell Potter (Ato Essandoh), is killed, Potter must put aside his contentious relationship with the Reagan family to get justice for his son.
When Eddie and Jamie become overly involved in a complicated adoption case between the birth and adoptive parents, they ask Erin to help them settle the dispute without going to court.
When Danny accepts a side job as a bodyguard for a recently released ex-con who took the fall for someone else, he uses the opportunity to go after the real criminal.
When diplomatic immunity complicates a child abuse case for Danny and Baez, Frank intervenes, despite not having jurisdiction on the case.
While investigating the murder of a gang leader, Danny and Baez learn the accused shooter is an ex-con who is romantically linked to his parole officer, who might be assisting in a cover up.

While investigating the murder of a man who killed a mother and son years earlier while driving drunk, Danny and Baez are torn between doing their job and finding justice after discovering the connection between the suspect and the victim.
When Linda's brother, Jimmy (Kevin Dillon), gets into trouble with the mob, he begs Danny to help him stay safe until it blows over.

Jamie and Eddie suspect foul play when they respond to a distress call from a woman having an allergic reaction to her lifesaving medication, and learn that her husband is an EMT assigned to take her call, but didn't respond.

Danny investigates the circumstances of an ex-NYPD officer who goes missing the day after she revealed to him that she had planned to make amends to the woman she and her partner wrongfully convicted years ago.
Hilarious sequel to "Any Friend Of Walter's" in which Obie leaves Walter in Hoss' care.
Ben must travel to pay his respects after he learns of the death of his nephew Will. When he visits the grave, he finds his nephew barely alive with a bullet wound.
Frank Medford, a figure from Ben's "wild, misspent youth", shows up in Virginia City, and though down on his luck, creates troubles for the Cartwrights by claiming to be a successful businessman.
The town council feels Roy Coffee can no longer do his job, and with the notorious Wagner gang on their way to rob the bank, everyone is in a panic.
A vain outlaw murders a man in front of witnesses, including Joe, but a clever lawyer is able to get him acquitted.
Ben helps Matthew Raine, a famous painter who has gone blind and now wallows in self-pity, discover a new purpose in life.  However, Raine's employee Gavin has other ideas.
The peaceful world of a Ponderosa hand is disturbed by the arrival of his no-good father and twin brother, who is a wanted man.
One of the wealthiest men in the world, Charles Augustus Hackett, offers to buy the Ponderosa, price no object.  Ben says the ranch is not for sale and Hackett refuses to give up.
Hoss hires Waldo as a ranch hand after keeping Waldo from killing himself.  Hoss soon learns that Waldo is lousy at his job and only causes problems for everyone else due to his clumsiness.
Hoss wants to marry mysterious Regan Miller, a woman with less than a pristine past.  When he thinks Adam is trying to steal her away, he loses control and beats Adam up.

programmes.st: Dark Enough to See the Stars
programmes.d: Young Billy Wilcox wanders onto the Ponderosa, sick, hungry, and alone.  Ben finds him, and after he regains his strength, offers Billy a job.
Ben assists Georgio Rossi in his battle for water on adjoining property.
The Pony Express sets up office in Virginia and Joe is one of the first to join up.  Ben also decides to invest in the fledgling enterprise.
Conclusion to the previous-week's episode, where the Cartwrights provide needed assistance to the Pony Express.

programmes.st: A Hot Day for a Hanging
programmes.d: Hoss is jailed for robbing the bank in Dutchman Flats, a town on the brink of economic collapse, even the sheriff knows he is innocent, but a lynch mob gathers and Hoss' fate is not good.
Hoss becomes concerned for the welfare of an insecure, belligerent fellow who is as small as Hoss is large.  Interesting blend of comedy and pathos that ends unpredictably.

When Cochise falls on Joe, Ben cannot help but remember that is how Marie Cartwright was killed.  He thinks back to meeting her in New Orleans in a rather confusing story not quite in synch with details discussed in "The First Born".
As Naruto sleeps, Kawaki repairs the vase he broke. Suddenly, Kurama, the Nine-Tailed Beast, appears before him.
Using the Transportation Technique, Sasuke arrives at a strange location that is covered with mysterious inscriptions. There he finds many surprising things about the Otsutsuki Clan.
A direct confrontation between Naruto, the Seventh Hokage, and Jigen, the leader of the Kara, finally begins!
Naruto and Sasuke work together to defeat Jigen in a fierce battle, but they struggle against Jigen's advanced fighting abilities and mysterious jutsu.
With the enemy's sudden appearance, Naruto, the Seventh Hokage and leader of the village, has vanished.
Boruto and the others attack Boro to save Naruto, but Boro drives them back by releasing a mysterious dark mist that paralyses his opponents.
The newly formed Team 7's all-out attack damages Boro, and their efforts seem to be successful. However, Boro uses his regenerative powers to revive himself.
Despite sustaining serious damage from the new Team 7, Boro goes on a mad rampage, threatening Boruto and the others with total annihilation.
Kawaki begins to worry that his presence puts Hidden Leaf Village at risk, especially since Kara is after him.
In order to learn more about Boro’s connection to Kara, Konohamaru and Sai are tasked with a mission to infiltrate Boro's cult.
Someone has stolen data about the Leaf Ninja, and it’s suspected a spy may have been planted inside the village.
Amado, a principal member of Kara who oversaw their research and development, kidnaps Shikadai and seeks asylum in the Leaf Village.
In exchange for being granted asylum in the Village Hidden in the Leaves, Amado reveals everything he knows.
The battle between Koji Kashin and Jigen begins at Kara’s hideout.
Isshiki finally appears in his true form and goes to attack the Hidden Leaf Village to capture Kawaki.
Boruto pulls Isshiki into another dimension for a final showdown.
Naruto and Sasuke fight fiercely, but their efforts are in vain as Isshiki drives them into a corner.
Momoshiki has taken control of Boruto’s consciousness and stands before them as an enemy.
Amado provides some new information concerning Code, whose powers surpass Jigen.
Naruto convenes a Five Kage Summit to discuss what they should do about Boruto’s condition, as well as Cord, one of the leaders of Kara.
Naruto, proposes that the Chunin Exam be held to raise morale after Isshiki’s attack.

programmes.st: The Night Before the Final Round
programmes.d: The final round of the Chunin Exam is announced.
Sasuke appears before Naruto to warn him of impending danger. An inconceivable foe lies in wait as Sasuke, the Five Kage and Boruto, charge into another dimension!
The final round of the exams has finally begun, and the first match is Inojin versus Houki.

programmes.st: The Legend of the Monster Cat
programmes.d: The next match in the final rounds is between Iwabe and Wasabi.
The match between Sarada and Cho-Cho begins.
Boruto and Mitsuki still have not appeared at the venue. Sarada worries that at this rate, the duo will be disqualified.
Mirai, who was on a mission with Konohamaru, returns to the village critically injured.

programmes.st: Kawaki's Path to Becoming a Ninja
programmes.d: In order for Kawaki to become a genin, it’s decided that he can take a special test that differs from the one held at the Ninja Academy
The Seventh Hokage gives Kawaki a last shot and assigns him to join Shikadai and Cho-Cho on a mission.

When two young boys are reported missing, a known neighborhood sex offender is the primary suspect.
While investigating an elderly woman's murder, Grissom receives a miniature crime scene replica; Greg attends a hearing to ascertain his culpability in a teenager's accidental death.

When identical twins are found dead, the evidence in both cases does not immediately prove a connection between the two deaths. However, as the CSIs dig deeper into the histories of the women, a surprising twist takes the investigation in a new direction.
Grissom and his team investigate a string of murders in Las Vegas that may be tied to an infamous mob boss from the 1970s who disappeared many years ago.
When the CSIs process clues after a murder at a poultry manufacturing plant, the evidence leads them to the home of a man who collects miniature trains and other miniature paraphernalia.

Catherine's testimony in court is not enough to convict a killer suspected of murdering his own mother. Adam Novak, with whom Catherine had a brief romantic encounter, is the lawyer who represents the killer and secures his freedom.
The lead suspect for the high-profile murder of anti-drug crusading assemblyman Danilo Zamesca is Thomas Simon, the west coast's biggest drug supplier.

As Catherine and Keppler begin to investigate the murder of a teen-aged Jane Doe, both agree that the killer, who was meticulous in removing evidence from the body and its surrounding area, is likely a repeat offender.
A case involving a man's torched corpse whose bones and tissues had been harvested leads Nick and Keppler into the disturbing world of illegally sold human body parts.
Grissom returns from his teaching sabbatical as new member of the team, Michael Keppler desperately tries to keep his dark past hidden from his colleagues.

With potentially less than a day to attempt to prevent the next murders, the CSI team must quickly shake off their shock that the true miniature killer is not the late Ernie Edward Dell, who committed suicide after confessing to the slayings.
Grissom's quip that two missing young lovers may have run off to Mexico is soon quashed by the discovery of drops of blood by the boy's vacant parking spot at the high school.
While processing the house where several showgirls were murdered, Sara is haunted by the terrified eyes and cryptic dying words of the sixth victim she discovers.

Greg is forced to again contend with the hostile mother and brother of the hoodlum he killed in self-defense several months ago when the CSI team discovers that the brother is involved in a new murder case.

While Grissom and the rest of the CSIs are out investigating new cases, Hodges leads Archie, Henry, Mandy and Wendy to believe that Grissom wants them to secretly band together that evening in an attempt to solve the four miniature killer cases.

In their attempt to identify the murderer of a has-been boxer who lived among a group of prostitutes who detested him, the CSIs must establish which of several life-threatening acts against him in one night actually killed him.
The CSI team investigates the murder of a blackjack dealer whose estranged husband has ties to a club of UFO believers.
South Beach Miami’s sexiest nightclub becomes a hotbed of revenge when murder closes the doors on a unique dating service.

The CSI team races against time to locate and deactivate a radioactive bomb set to go off in the middle of downtown Miami.

After fishermen catch a tiger shark and discover a partial human torso in its stomach, evidence leads the team to suspect murder.

Carla falls head over heals for hockey star Eddie LeBec, a newly acquired goalie for the Bruins.
Carla realizes she's the reason Eddie's hockey game is suffering.

Cliff files a lawsuit and ends up getting blindsided by the beautiful defendant.
The regulars meet over dinner to discuss Frasier asking Lilith to move in.

Sam flips out when his goddaughter visits and agrees to move in with Woody.
Norm lies about the prestige of his new position at a CPA firm.
Woody's parents want him to move back home, but the regulars try to keep him.

With Sam and Diane's wedding day approaching, big questions still loom.
Sam returns to Cheers after sailing around the world and wants his job back.
Buddy and Duff make magic as they compete with cakes for Penn and Teller.
Buddy and Duff lay it all on the line in the final rounds of competition.

Buddy and Duff try to out-do each other with their pirate cakes.
Buddy and Duff face off in an architecture challenge.
For the competition finale, Buddy and Duff create monster cakes.

Mark and the guys sit down to talk about their favorite jobs.
Mark and crew build a beautiful log cabin addition for an old brick home.
The Barnwood Builders work close to home to salvage a barn in Alderson, WV.

The Barnwood Builders save a barn from an iron-mining boomtown in VA.
The guys work on a 19th century cabin they took down in Ripley, WV.
The guys salvage logs from a PA barn for a guesthouse in upstate NY.

Mark and his crew save a cabin with sawn logs and a surprising history.
The crew saves an 1830s log home and tears down an old log barn.

Chip and Jo come up with ways to bring the outdoors into the overall space.

A waning director revives his career after discovering a beautiful Spanish dancer and makes her into a Hollywood star. Ava Gardner, Humphrey Bogart and Edmond O’Brien star in this bitter tale of stardom won and wasted from Joseph L. Mankiewicz.

Aerialist Burt Lancaster--who retired after suffering an injury--agrees to train aspiring trapeze artist Tony Curtis. But when both men fall in love with the beautiful and ambitious Gina Lollobrigida, the triangle threaten the dreams of them all.
Tony Curtis gives a winning performance as the great Houdini, the struggling circus performer who emerged as the world’s most captivating magician and escape artist.

Charlton Heston stars as Brad Braden, the circus manager who lives and breathes to keep the show rolling. With the Big Top about to hit rock bottom, Braden hires The Great Sebastian, a daring trapeze legend, to revitalize the circus.

It's 1944, and Nazi forces along the Siegfried Line have the numbers, the fortifications and the firepower to break through. GIs have little more than a dogged determination and the ingenuity to fool the Germans into thinking they are allies.

Steve McQueen stars as a sophisticated but bored tycoon who pulls off a bank heist so stunning that even Boston's finest are baffled. Faye Dunaway is the sleek insurance investigator out to bring him in but who, ultimately, falls in love with him.
From the Pulitzer Prize-Winning novel by William Faulkner, Steve McQueen stars in the story of a Mississippi boy who drives to Memphis with two rascals in his family's new car—a 1905 Winton Flyer.
Edith is chosen to appear in a tv commericial but finds herself unable to lie when she begins to doubt the quality of the sponsor's detergent.
Archie refuses to let Edith's elderly aunt move into their spare bedroom, even after she's been turned away by every other relative.
A UFO has been sighted over Tuckahoe, but no one believes it because it's Maude who's spotted it.
The liberated woman has no place in society...at least that is what Victoria Butterfield's father professes and Maude protests.

Maude's all-out campaign to get a well-deserved salary raise for one of Walter's female employees backfires when the lady decides to take the raise...and Walter, too. Marcia Rodd guest stars as Walter's overly liberated employee.
The generation gap becomes the Grand Canyon when Maude agrees to chaperone Phillip's birthday party and comes face to face with today's youth.
Arthur instigates a doctors' strike, refusing to treat 'any' patients, but his convictions could prove to be very unhealthy when Walter and Vivian take ill.
Maude's up to her libido in sexual fantasies over a handsome government ecologist and Walter's up to his ears in jealousy.

Mechanic Latka Gravas’ youthful and attractive mother makes her first visit to America, and after she and Alex meet and have an evening love affair, Latka assumes that he will soon be getting a new daddy.

programmes.st: Alex Tastes Death & Finds A Nice Restaurant
programmes.d: When Alex’s ear is nearly shot off in a holdup attempt in his cab, he stuns his fellow cabbies by quitting and exchanging his driving clothes for a waiter’s tuxedo at a snobbish French restaurant.

The cabbies fall victim to a Hollywood-style roller coaster ride when a production company visits to do a film on taxi drivers. Life at the Sunshine Cab Company turns into a continual champagne and buffet festivity.
When John crashes Cab 804, the cabbies are shocked into a period of mourning, as they reminisce about the wild and memorable events that occurred when they were driving the legendary cab.

programmes.st: It’s All Over Now, Baby Bird
programmes.d: Felix's pet parrot takes a turn for the worse, and Oscar, who never liked the bird, offers to handle the burial arrangements.
Over Oscar's objections, Felix recounts to their dates how they met while serving on a jury.

Felix volunteers on behalf of Oscar and himself to take care of a small boy. But on his first visit, the boy is indifferent to the cultural program Felix has planned and fascinated by sloppy Oscar and his hobbies and habits.

Felix takes refuge with friends Murray and Mimi when Oscar, in the throes of a hangover, asks him to leave in The Breakup.  He is convinced that all he has to do is wait until Oscar feels better, but he is wrong.
Bub's new neighbor causes trouble.
The hunt for a stamp overshadows Chip's big announcement.
Robbie decides to enter a rock and roll contest.
The Douglas family goes to Scotland.
Mel wants a magazine reporter to watch the writers at work, but Rob thinks they'll all end up performing for the reporter instead of getting anything done.
Rob is once again forced to thwart another scheme of his old but manipulative friend, Neil Schenk.
Rob receives a ransom demand of $2,500 for his lost television script.
Rob resorts to psychological warfare to get even with a practical joker.
Uncle Joe tries to get rid of the pet chimp who is gradually wrecking the Shady Rest hotel.
Uncle Joe discovers that the 75th anniversary of the railroad between Hooterville & Pixley is approaching, and seeks to take control of the ceremony.

programmes.st: But I've Never Been in Erie, PA

Bobbie Jo attempts to soften up Billie's Jo's new boyfriend for marriage.
Selme Plout's scheme to snag a husband for her daughter almost forces Steve out of the crop-dusting business.
Orrin Pike is osserved buying a ring, and the family jumps to the conclusion that he's going to propose to Bobbie Jo.
Carter's adopted Korean daughter arrives, but she's not the little girl he remembers.
Carter tries for the Officer Candidate School.
After spending twelve years in prison for a rape, torture, and murder, a young punk returns to San Francisco to seek revenge against Mike Stone, who was the arresting officer.
A father finds out that the man who murdered his son is released on a technicality.
Mike Stone has reason to believe that the death of a politician is no accident.
A priest won't tell Stone where a murderer is hiding. Stakes are raised by drug smugglers looking for a stolen shipment of heroin.

Against his better judgment, Mannix agrees to look into the case of a young man who twice robbed the same pharmacy seeking drugs. The second time, he shot one of the employees, but even though the police had the pharmacy staked out, he managed to escape.
Joe Mannix is invited to a party at the home of Phil Graves, with whom he served in the Army during the Korean War. Now Phil is a bank executive married to a wealthy socialite named Kathy.
When Mannix tries to find out what a disturbed little girl knows about her murdered doctor and $150,000 in stolen bonds, they both become marked for assassination.
Peggy and her son are held hostage by men who want the evidence that Mannix has, that proves his detective friend was murdered.
Betty goes undercover to help Barnaby, J.R. search for a missing young girl. They soon find out that what they've stumbled onto it is a white slavery racket.

While attending a sporting event Barnaby thinks he's spotted a man who robbed over $500,000 in gold from the gold exchange nearly 10 years ago. He's also believed to have died in a plane crash over the ocean while making off with the loot.

A friend and fellow Community College instructor of Betty's is raped. Much to her dismay, Betty feels that her friend has wrongly identified her attacker and she refuses to reconsider. Barnaby and J.R. help to find the real rapist.

A counselor at a Fresh Start program for kids with drug problems dies in an accident after allegedly getting high on drugs. J.R. goes undercover as his replacement to find out who has been smuggling those drugs into their school.

McGarrett watches with stunned realization as the state's rock-solid murder case against Islands racketeer Kum Chi suddenly vaporizes because McGarrett has been suckered by the prosecution's star witness.
McGarrett & Five-O investigate a deadly fire at Honolulu's Global Trade Center. Sub-standard materials caused the rapid spread. Targets: corrupt contractor & inspector taking bribes.
McGarrett & Five-O hunt for killers of a girl & hang-glider pilot. Slow progress until victim's roommate, burdened by guilt, risks life to aid McGarrett.

Three criminals plan to devastate the Hawaiian sugar cane industry by importing a borer moth with no known cure or natural predator. Their goal is to ruin the land, allowing one of them to purchase it at a low price.
A Japanese female terrorist, with American scientists, kidnaps industrialist's son & demands $1.5m ransom. Five-O team races to save boy held in capsule with 52hr air supply before suffocating.

Albert determines that neither Leo nor Jacques killed Laura, but he is unable find any leads into who shot Cooper. Cooper says they must find the third man, who he believes to be Bob, the gray-haired man.

programmes.st: Hunter: S4 E6 - City Of Passion, Part 1

programmes.st: Hunter: S4 E7 - City Of Passion, Part 2
programmes.d: A serial rapist known as Big Foot stalks McCall while Hunter investigates the death of a teenage prostitute who may have had ties to a Satanic cult.

programmes.st: Hunter: S4 E8 - City Of Passion, Part 3
programmes.d: McCall risks losing her job when she fails to report a felony, and Hunter tries to trap the killer of a teenage prostitute with possible ties to a Satanic cult.

Dr. Sloan's day begins with a phone call from a kidnapper who happened to dial the wrong number - his! The kidnapper believes he's called the original victim and demands Dr. Sloan deliver money if he wants to see his son alive.

A homicide investigation turns into a federal case when a "corpse" creates a reign of terror at Community General. Amanda prepares for her autopsy on blood-soaked John Doe when he springs to life, putting a stranglehold on Amanda!
After heading out to a mountain cabin, Jesse goes missing, only to turn up five days later in Utah, claiming to have been abducted by aliens.

Walker and Trivette are in the midst of investigating a trio of college students who use the drug Rohypnol to subdue unsuspecting female victims in nightclubs when their friend Darcy Reynolds is raped on her 21st birthday.

Eight years previous, a bank robbery resulted in the sheriff being killed, and the criminals escaping in a small plane. Current day, the plane is found crashed in the mountains. Walker and Alex investigate, riding into the rough country.
Alex, C.D. and a group of fifth- and sixth-grade students from a Dallas-area elementary school are kidnapped by mercenaries, who demand $10 million in ransom.
Walker's friend Father Blake is besieged by a ruthless developer who plans to build shoddy condominiums on the same site that the priest has announced plans to build a shelter for the homeless.
In a teeming city, Kimble befriends an immigrant's young son, who, through a twist of fate, soon becomes his protector.
In Washington, D.C., Kimble gets the protection of an African Ambassador, but he incurs the hostility of the Ambassador's wife.
Kimble falls in love with a girl who happens to be a daytime parolee from a woman's prison.

In the wilderness, MacGyver and 10-year-old Darin Cooper intervene to save the lives of a pair of golden eagles injured by poachers. The poachers go after MacGyver -- witness to their crime -- and taking Darin and his mother hostage.
MacGyver's loyalties are put to the test when the KGB challenges him to steal a touring Chinese artifact in exchange for the release of a woman he once loved.
MacGyver heists an ancient Chinese artifact as a ransom for a woman he once loved, only to learn she's double-crossed him.
The Bundy's stay at the shoe store after their house is tented for termites. A grounded Kelly plots to escape and go to a rock concert.
Marcy regrets denting Steve's new car when he claims that she's made him impotent.
Robbie and his friend Hank need money to go on dates, so they decide to start a business for home repairs and outdoor chores.
Tramp gets framed.
An unexpected visitor catches Steve by surprise.
Chip sees a ghost while trick-or-treating.
Dennis decides to help along a potential romance between an older friend of his and a new girl in town.
Dennis is appointed by the mayor to go to Washington to ask their senator to support the creation of a national forest at nearby Hickory Mountain.
The star player on Dennis' basketball team, Stretch, quits the team because Johnny Brady and some of the other players constantly make fun of him.
Mr. Wilson is convinced that he is allergic to Dennis because he sneezes every time Dennis is around.

programmes.t: Father Knows Best: The House Painter
programmes.d: The Anderson's are getting their house painted. This starts a moral discussion and the family wage a bet. Betty and Jim are having a discussion about responsibility and pride in a job well done versus the old mighty dollar.

programmes.t: Father Knows Best: Bud, The Wallflower
programmes.d: Bud is depressed because he has not been invited to the Sadie Hawkins dance at school. He decides to plan a camping trip.

programmes.t: Father Knows Best: The Bus to Nowhere
programmes.d: Betty has been depressed for over a week. No one has been able to cheer her up. Betty seems to be facing a personal crisis and is searching for the meaning of life.

programmes.t: Father Knows Best: Kathy, The Indian Giver
programmes.d: Kathy is much younger than Bud and Betty. Though they love her they often do want to play with her. Kathy is tired of being left alone with her dolls to play. She wants to have a real baby sister to play with.
The family goes on vacation to Indiana, where Cissy, Buffy, and Jody grew up. Bill wants them to touch base with the relatives still living there and to see their hometown.
Buffy and Jody accidentally break a small statue originally from Columbia and try to fix it before Uncle Bill finds out about it.
Jody's newest hero figure is a football superstar who is Uncle Ken to one of Jody's friends. When Jody finds out that Ken is suspended from the team for placing bets, Jody is disillusioned.
The twins play matchmaker for Uncle Bill so he has someone in his life when they get older and move out.

Jan feels disrespected and ignored by her brothers and sisters, so she tells everyone that she wishes she was an only child. Meanwhile, Carol and Alice have a competition over who can cook the best strawberry preserves.

Mike thinks Greg wants to be an architect after reading Greg's school essay, but Greg doesn't want to hurt Mike's feelings and tell him the truth. Meanwhile, the other Brady kids also begin thinking about their future careers.

The kids give Alice the cold shoulder after they think she has broken their trust, so Alice decides to leave her job as housekeeper. However, the kids soon regret the decision after the new housekeeper teaches them a lesson.
Marcia thinks that a girl who is suddenly interested in Greg is actually using him so that Greg will vote for her as head cheerleader--over Marcia.

Peter tries out for the role of George Washington in a school play, but gets the role of Benedict Arnold instead. But he then wants to quit the play altogether when his classmates start branding him as a "traitor."
Marcia has a crush on her new dentist, which only intensifies when she mistakes an opportunity to babysit for him as a date with him to the ballet.

Louise Jefferson returns for a visit at the Bunker's place to ask Edith if she can sell her (Louise's) former house. Edith doubts but Archie makes her agree so that they (mostly he) can choose white people to move in.

When Archie's brother, Fred, visits Archie to open up a business, he also brings his 18 year old wife, Katherine. Both, Archie and Edith, and even Stephanie, are shocked as they find out. Archie and Fred argue about Katherine's age.
Stephanie's father, Floyd, finally arrives with a devastating proposition for the Bunkers: They can keep Stephanie if they agree to pay him $1000 cash!

On Archie's St. Patrick's Day Party at the tavern, he discovers that Edith is terribly ill after doing a lot of cooking for him. Sidney comes to the rescue and is able to save Edith before it's too late.

When Cousin Liz dies, Edith and Archie learn more about her than they ever thought. When a roomate of Liz, Veronica, comes out of the closet to Edith, she also admits that she was more than just roomates with Liz.

Archie must delay his weekend fishing trip with Barney when Edith announces that she has invited people from the SunShine Home to attend an elderly couple's wedding at 704 on the same day Archie planned to leave.
When Kelsey finally decides to sell his bar, nothing will stop Archie from getting it--even if it means forging Edith's signature against her will.
Edith is upset when she discovers Archie has forged her signature to get the bar. But Mike will influence Mrs. Bunker to change her mind.
After going to a cousin's funeral, Mama plans a suitable funeral for herself. However, it will require their savings for vacation and for her to bow out of the bowling competition.

Argentinian star pianist Martha Argerich celebrates her 80th birthday performing at Château de Chantilly, France; in this concert, recorded at the festival Les Coups de Cœur de Chantilly, Argerich is joined by three musicians.

A firework display with music from Hollywood films.
